description: Exercise 376: retain all six source groups and given axes. The two same-left-facing head/bust-like natural objects use one inspected GPT artwork asset twice with exact translation, never hand-polygon silhouettes or a corrected mirror image.

authoritativeText.text: 图 93 中哪些图形是关于已知轴的对称图形？

inventory.description: Upper-left pair about s: each consists of one triangle, one oblique rod reaching a circle, one circle, one vertical stem, one horizontal rectangular base and one narrow end compartment. Left base compartment is at the left; right compartment at the right. All defining vertices/endpoints and circle centers match reflection. Hidden vertices are construction helpers; no new point markers.

Upper-right pair about l: equal rectangles, each with one equal circle, left circle toward the outside-left and right circle toward the outside-right. Circle positions as well as rectangle outlines are reflected; not centered circles.

Original right-middle pair about k consists of two same-left-facing compact head/bust-like natural objects with a left notch/snouted profile, rounded raised top and right curved back, and flat lower edge. No source vertex count is claimed for organic contours. Modern semantic artwork must be generated from the actual source PNG and inspected before use; one identical raster is duplicated with a 96px translation, no flip/rotation. The fit boxes and exact translation are modern placement, not printed dimensions. All original six groups and existing k remain; no hand-polygon silhouette or corrected reflection is allowed.

Two equal squares straddle horizontal n: upper one is left of lower one; both are separated equally from n, but lower is shifted a full square width right. Preserve horizontal mismatch rather than aligning them as an answer.

Lower-left pair about horizontal a: upper polyline has four upward peaks, three interior low troughs, left short horizontal lead and raised right tail; lower has four upward peaks and four deep troughs, a shorter lead and raised right tail. Lower is not the reflected upper: preserve the phase, vertex count and endpoint mismatch; do not regularize into a symmetric zigzag.

Lower-right pair: two equal circles centered at equal perpendicular distances from vertical m. No visible center points, extra diameters or answer markers in the source; construction centers remain hidden.
